name: ItemLedger
description: On-chain Object Layer registry, ownership and provenance projections: canonical Object Layer CIDs bound to ERC-1155 token types, with supply and holder projections. Pre-Alpha.
featureList: Registration of a canonical Object Layer as an asset
Token id derived from the Object Layer CID
Ownership and supply projections from ledger state
keywords: itemledger, object layer, registry, ERC-1155, token, provenance, ownership, IPFS, CID

name: ItemLedger
description: The domain that binds canonical Object Layer CIDs to ERC-1155 token types and projects ownership and provenance.

acceptedAnswer.text: ItemLedger is the bridge between canonical Object Layers and their economic representation. It registers a definition as an asset, binds it to an ERC-1155 token type, and projects ownership and provenance from ledger state.

mainEntity.name: How is a token id assigned?

acceptedAnswer.text: The token id is derived from the canonical Object Layer CID: uint256(sha256(cid)). The same content always gets the same token id. Different definitions get different token ids even when they share an item name.
Ownership is the ERC-1155 balance of each holder on-chain. ItemLedger indexes it. The Object Layer content itself never carries an owner.

mainEntity.name: Can I register an asset today?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not on a public network. ItemLedger is Pre-Alpha: the registration path, the projections and the contract are written and tested, but no public network holds a deployment, so every on-chain read is unavailable until one does.
